svg.aria-label: II · PRECISION · EGYPTIAN. In the hall of judgment, Anubis weighed the heart against a feather before anyone could pass. Every change I ship goes through the same kind of scale: lint, tests with mocks instead of real paid APIs, coverage on the lines that changed, and a quality gate that blocks bugs, vulnerabilities and leaked secrets. The Eye of Ra watches after it ships.
